messages.content:
You are the operations assistant on the Larkspur Home online store's customer-support desk, working for the shift lead in this conversation. You must use the facts, rules, corrections, and withdrawals stated earlier in the conversation: a correction replaces the earlier value, and a withdrawn rule no longer applies. When a request concerns an order id or account number from the conversation, you must call lookup_order or lookup_customer with it before you answer. When a fact you need is not in view, you must call recall with a topic (a customer name, an order or account id, or a desk topic) to recover it from the full conversation record. Finish every request with your complete answer as your final message; that message is what the shift lead receives. Never cite a handle such as m12 or r5 in your answer.

## Instructions

Today is Thursday 2026-10-08.

## Pinned
### Luis Ferreira (account LH-44870)
- Last one for the morning: Luis Ferreira on account LH-44870 wants to return an opened stand mixer from order LH-79215.
- Order LH-79215 for account LH-44870 (Luis Ferreira): stand mixer, 5 quart, total $289.00.
- Delivered 2026-09-21; return window open until 2026-10-21.
- Before you work on Luis: the director scrapped the 15 percent restocking fee this morning.
- Opened-item returns get a full refund again.
- Account LH-44870: Luis Ferreira, Standard tier, member since 2023-02-08.
- Refund method on file is Mastercard ending 7719; email luis.ferreira@example.net.

## Rules
- Standing rule: any refund over $200 needs a manager approval code in the internal note.
- Marcus just messaged that the approval code rotated early.
- Use MX-4486 from now on; MX-4471 is dead.
- Third rule: copy Priya Raman from the refunds team on every escalation.
- And never promise a customer a delivery date in writing.
- For anything stuck at a carrier depot, Tomasz Brennan in the warehouse issues the release.
- Tomasz Brennan: He's off tomorrow, Friday 2026-10-09, so release requests have to reach him today.
Last one for the morning: Luis Ferreira on account LH-44870 wants to return an opened stand mixer from order LH-79215.
lookup_order {"id":"LH-79215"}: result shown under Pinned in the system message
LH-79215 is a $289.00 stand mixer delivered 2026-09-21, inside the return window that runs to 2026-10-21.
Before you work on Luis: the director scrapped the 15 percent restocking fee this morning. Opened-item returns get a full refund again.
Understood, the restocking fee rule is withdrawn and opened-item returns are refunded in full.
The coffee machine on the third floor is finally fixed, so I'm grabbing a cup before we start sending replies.
Enjoy it. I'll be ready when you're back.
Draft the internal note authorizing Luis's mixer refund, and include everything our refund rules require for an amount that size.

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up a Larkspur Home order by its order id, such as LH-12345.

function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Look up a Larkspur Home customer account by its account number, such as LH-12345.

function.name: recall
function.description: Recall what the full conversation record holds on a topic: an owner name, an id, or one of the desk topics refunds, returns, escalations, delivery, warehouse, contacts. Returns source lines, newest first.
